# shadcn-solidjs

> shadcn-solidjs is an unofficial, community-led SolidJS port of shadcn/ui: a collection of beautifully-designed, accessible components and a code distribution platform. This version is built for Solid 2.0 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, and headless primitives from Kobalte. Open Source. Open Code. AI-Ready. It also comes with a command-line tool to install and manage components and a registry system to publish and distribute code.

## Overview

- [Introduction](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/introduction): Core principles—Open Code, Composition, Distribution, Beautiful Defaults, and AI-Ready design.
- [Components](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components): Index of every component available in the library.
- [CLI](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/cli): Command-line tool for installing and managing components.
- [Figma](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/figma): Figma design resources.

## Installation

- [Installation](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/installation): How to install dependencies and structure your app.
- [Solid](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/installation/solid): Install and configure a Solid 2.0 project.

## Components

### Form & Input

- [Field](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/field): Combine labels, controls, and help text to compose accessible form fields and grouped inputs.
- [Button](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/button): Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.
- [Button Group](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/button-group): A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.
- [Input](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/input): A text input component for forms and user data entry with built-in styling and accessibility features.
- [Input Group](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/input-group): Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.
- [Input OTP](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/input-otp): Accessible one-time password component with copy-paste functionality.
- [Textarea](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/textarea): Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.
- [Checkbox](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/checkbox): A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
- [Radio Group](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/radio-group): A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.
- [Select](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/select): Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.
- [Native Select](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/native-select): A styled native HTML select element with consistent design system integration.
- [Switch](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/switch): A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
- [Slider](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/slider): An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.
- [Combobox](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/combobox): Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.
- [Label](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/label): Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

### Layout & Navigation

- [Accordion](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/accordion): A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.
- [Breadcrumb](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/breadcrumb): Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.
- [Navigation Menu](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/navigation-menu): A collection of links for navigating websites.
- [Sidebar](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/sidebar): A composable, themeable and customizable sidebar component.
- [Tabs](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/tabs): A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.
- [Separator](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/separator): Visually or semantically separates content.
- [Scroll Area](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/scroll-area): Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.
- [Resizable](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/resizable): Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.

### Overlays & Dialogs

- [Dialog](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/dialog): A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.
- [Alert Dialog](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/alert-dialog): A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.
- [Sheet](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/sheet): Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.
- [Drawer](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/drawer): A drawer component for Solid.
- [Popover](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/popover): Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.
- [Tooltip](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/tooltip): A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.
- [Hover Card](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/hover-card): For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.
- [Context Menu](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/context-menu): Displays a menu of actions triggered by a right click.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/dropdown-menu): Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.
- [Menubar](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/menubar): A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.
- [Command](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/command): Command menu for search and quick actions.

### Feedback & Status

- [Alert](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/alert): Displays a callout for user attention.
- [Toast](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/toast): A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.
- [Progress](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/progress): Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.
- [Spinner](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/spinner): An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.
- [Skeleton](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/skeleton): Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.
- [Badge](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/badge): Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.
- [Empty](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/empty): Use the Empty component to display an empty state.

### Display & Media

- [Avatar](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/avatar): An image element with a fallback for representing the user.
- [Card](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/card): Displays a card with header, content, and footer.
- [Table](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/table): A responsive table component.
- [Carousel](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/carousel): A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.
- [Aspect Ratio](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/aspect-ratio): Displays content within a desired ratio.
- [Item](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/item): A versatile component for displaying content with media, title, description, and actions.
- [Kbd](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/kbd): Used to display textual user input from keyboard.

### Chat & Messaging

- [Message](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/message): Displays a message in a conversation, with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment.
- [Message Scroller](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/message-scroller): A chat scroll container that anchors turns, opens saved transcripts, follows streamed responses, loads history without jumping, and jumps to any message.
- [Bubble](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/bubble): Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.
- [Marker](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/marker): Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation.
- [Attachment](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/attachment): Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload state, and actions.

### Misc

- [Collapsible](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/collapsible): An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.
- [Toggle](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/toggle): A two-state button that can be either on or off.
- [Toggle Group](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/toggle-group): A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.
- [Pagination](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/components/pagination): Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.

## Dark Mode

- [Dark Mode](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/dark-mode): Adding dark mode to your site.
- [Dark Mode - Solid](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/docs/dark-mode/solid): Dark mode setup for a Solid app.

## Registry

- [Component Registry](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/r/button.json): Every component is served as a registry item at `/r/{name}.json`, installable with `npx @ptzburn/shadcn-solidjs@beta add {name}`.

### Schemas

- [components.json Schema](https://v2.shadcn-solidjs.com/schema.json): JSON Schema for `components.json`. Defines the Tailwind stylesheet and base color, the icon library, path aliases, and additional registries. There is no `rsc` field (Solid has no React Server Components), no `tailwind.config` (Tailwind v4 only), and only `"tsx": true` is supported.
